name: README Update
description: Update README when package.json or core features change

actions.prompt:
Package information or core constants have changed. Please:
1. Check if version number in README matches package.json
2. Update feature list if constants changed
3. Verify installation instructions are current
4. Update any version-specific information
5. Ensure all links and references are working

Keep changes minimal and focused on accuracy.
actions.description: Keep README synchronized with project changes
